description: Sharpened replacement for I078, gated on the committee's shared crux (do ReLU's saved bytes reach 3%?). Step 1 is offline, with no repo change. On the E049 tip code with synthetic channels_last batch-2000 data, compile the 32 px whitening-detached, group-1-frozen and group-1+2-frozen steps and the 28 px step twice: GELU vs ReLU in all conv groups. Measure GPU kernel time per step (torch.profiler, 20 steps each), and record whether Inductor's ReLU backward saves a bool mask or the fp16 output. Weight the per-step savings by the tip's step counts per phase. Step 2 runs only if the projected saving is ≥3% of train time: commit the ReLU swap, recapture every variant in build with error_on_recompile on, and judge on seeds 13–32 against a same-build E049 baseline plus seeds 0–2. If the projected saving is under 3%, close H6.5's activation branch with no run.
